Current eligibility with unchanged Assessment Date and relevant-field changes uses Maintenance Date only in that rule path
Regression guard against incorrect Maintenance Date span splitting on update files
gaps: TC_001 Description lacks scenario coverage for hint line "Coverage follows the programme's manual matrix for this story: (Assessment Date changed vs not changed) x (existing member vs future eligibility) x relevant-field variations - including MULTI-FIELD COMBINATIONS as their own conditions (e.g. Assessment Number + Tier + Division together, and an All Relevant Fields Updated condition per quadrant)."

TS_006 also requires "MULTI-FIELD COMBINATIONS as their own conditions (e.g. Assessment Number + Tier + Division together, and an All Relevant Fields Updated condition per quadrant)"; add a dedicated test case for it

TC_002 Description says "with a changed Assessment Date in Loop 2300 HD03 does not use the Maintenance Date in Loop 2000 DTP*303 to split spans" but does not cover the clause "if the Assessment Date has changed and none of the relevant fields have changed, the Assessment Date populates as the transaction effective date, maintaining values of relevant fields."

TS_006 also requires "if the Assessment Date has changed and none of the relevant fields have changed, the Assessment Date populates as the transaction effective date, maintaining values of relevant fields."; add a dedicated test case for it
